Html:
Is  your component capable returning a digitial signature with a "ds" prefix?

Microsoft's default tool for SignedXML returns a Signature element but with no "ds" prefix, and if you try to manipulate the XML later
and add a "ds" prefix to the node the digital signature breaks.

after computing singature, default SignedXML GetXml() returns :
---------------------------
<Signature xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#>
...
</Signature>


need it to return :
---------------------------
<ds:Signature xmlns:ds="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#>
...
</ds:Signature>
